HOW IT WORKS

One brief in.
Comparable options back.

We run every pilot request by hand: clarify the scope, find suitable makers, normalise the numbers and show what is included.

THE PROCESS

01

Show us the problem

Send a drawing, photo or sketch, rough dimensions and quantity, where it is going and when you need it. An existing quote helps us understand what needs to improve.

02

We source and clarify

We approach makers who may be able to produce it, ask the same scope questions and flag missing compliance, freight or installation assumptions.

03

You compare the whole cost

Within seven days, we aim to return up to three options in AUD with inclusions, exclusions, lead time and the delivered-cost calculation made visible.

THE NUMBER THAT MATTERS

Not just the factory price.

A cheap ex-works number is not a project cost. We compare the parts that can change the decision.

  • Factory supply
  • Freight and customs charges
  • Duty assumptions
  • GST
  • Third-party inspection
  • Delivery to site
  • Installation allowance, where scoped

AN HONEST OUTPUT

Local may still be the right answer.

If the imported option is not cheaper, practical or compliant, we say so. The pilot is designed to find a workable sourcing route—not force every project overseas.

PILOT OFFER

Free for our first 10 projects.

No obligation to order. Every job is handled personally by the team.
